description: The file defines the ResponseInterface, an interface representing an HTTP response in PSR-7, including methods for obtaining and setting status codes, reason phrases, and inheriting message properties.

classes.name: ResponseInterface
classes.description: Interface representing an HTTP response message, including status code, reason phrase, headers, and message body, extending MessageInterface.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP response status code as an integer.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified status code and optional reason phrase, maintaining immutability.

methods.name: getReasonPhrase
methods.description: Returns the reason phrase associated with the response's status code, or an empty string if none.
